how medieval monks made
illuminated manuscripts

the room

the scriptorium, lit
only by daylight.

the gold

leaf so thin it
floats on a breath.

the blue

ultramarine, ground from lapis
lazuli carried from afghanistan.

the masterpiece

the book of kells, around 800,
still in dublin.

the margins

monks drew knights fighting
snails. i laughed when i
learned that.
